events.factual_description: TACHIKAWA STAGE GARDEN and DISK GARAGE present Toshiki Kadomatsu's TOSHIKI KADOMATSU 45th Anniversary Live 〜御礼参り〜 on Saturday, September 5, 2026, with doors at 16:30 and the performance at 17:30. The venue lists Kadomatsu as the performer and standard reserved seats at ¥11,000 including tax. DISK GARAGE also lists ¥11,000 third-floor seated-designated seats and ¥6,000 third-floor restricted-view seats. Kadomatsu's official Sony Music site originally announced the autumn 2026 tour with Tachikawa as the opening date; his official profile states that he debuted in June 1981, making 2026 his 45th-anniversary year. The anniversary context is broader than a single night: DISK GARAGE documents the June 27 Yokohama Arena anniversary concert and multiple autumn 2026 dates after Tachikawa.

en.why_it_matters: Kadomatsu is a durable Tokyo-rooted thread in Japanese groove: a singer, writer and producer whose catalogue has connected polished urban pop with funk, R&B and meticulous studio craft since his 1981 debut. Tachikawa opens the autumn leg of his formal 45th-anniversary year under the 〜御礼参り〜 banner, turning the tour into a return of thanks rather than just another legacy date. The draw is hearing that living catalogue in the hands of the artist who has spent four and a half decades shaping both the recordings and their large-scale live life.
en.trip_verdict: If you are in Greater Tokyo/Kanto, actively make room for Tachikawa and let the concert anchor the evening. From outside Kanto, I would fold it into an existing Tokyo plan rather than rebuild a Japan itinerary solely around September 5, because this anniversary cycle continues through multiple cities.

es.why_it_matters: Kadomatsu es un hilo duradero del groove japonés con raíz en Tokio: cantante, compositor y productor cuyo catálogo ha unido pop urbano pulido, funk, R&B y un oficio de estudio minucioso desde su debut de 1981. Tachikawa abre el tramo otoñal de su año formal de 45 aniversario bajo la idea de 〜御礼参り〜, una vuelta de agradecimiento que le da a la gira un contexto más concreto que otra fecha de catálogo. La razón para ir es escuchar ese repertorio todavía vivo en manos del artista que lleva cuatro décadas y media moldeando tanto las grabaciones como su vida en escenarios grandes.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en Greater Tokyo/Kanto, sí le haría espacio activamente y dejaría que el concierto ancle la tarde-noche. Desde fuera de Kanto lo metería en un plan de Tokio ya existente, en vez de rehacer un itinerario por Japón únicamente por el 5 de septiembre, porque este ciclo de aniversario continúa por varias ciudades.
